scientific_integrity: The Lee–Yang theorem is credited for the nonnegative-coupling regime; finite exact checks supplement but do not replace the analytical all-N proof. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite periodic Ising rings, N>=3, common positive bulk K, two equal defect bonds of real coupling L; no unequal-bond, thermodynamic-limit or higher-dimensional theorem. General covering literature may remain unindexed.
title: Parity-dependent Lee–Yang circle breakdown for a two-bond Ising impurity
